paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu hong tung a, ka kiang ah,
heading: Tura Vuina La

paite: "Nang, mihing tapa, Tura kho suunna la phuak inla,
Tura khua kiang ah, Aw nang tuipi gei a teng sek, tuipi gei gam tampite kiang a sumsin, Toupa PATHIAN in huchi in ahon chi: Aw nang Tura, ka kilawm bukim na chi maw;
"Na gam in tuipi lai asun hi, nang hon bawlte'n hon kilawm tungtuansak mah ve ua;
Na singzat Senir meilah in abawl ua; na longpeu ding in, Lebanon a sidar in abawl uhi;
Bashan tosaw na longzapna ding in abawl ua; saiha suangphum na long pialkhang ding in, taksing tuipi gam Kupra a kipan in.
Na long puanzak Aigupta puanmalngat gial, nang chiamtehna ding in ana tung hi, nang a dia limzak dumpuang, sandup, Elishah tui gei a kipan;
Na longkalmi Sidon, Arvad mi ahi; na long hawl mite leng Zemir misiamte ahi ua;
Gebal upa leh mikhutsiam, na long bulhtuah mite ahi ua, tuipi long teng leh amite'n, nang hong dawr ding in ahong zuan uhi.
"Na galdoumi, na sepaihhon, Persia, Lud, Put mite ahi ua, alum uh leh adal lukhu uh na baang ah akhai ua, nang kilawmsakte ahi uhi.
Na sepaihhon leh Arvad mite'n na kulhpi kimvel in aveng ua, Gammadim mite'n na insang aveng ua, alum uh na kulhpi kimvel in akhai ua, nang kilawmsakte ahi uhi.
Na hauh ziak in, sum-le-pai gou thil chiteng, Tarshish nang hon dawr mi ahong hi a, na van lei in ahon lam hi, dangkasik, sik, langva leh asuante leng.
Zavan, Tubal, Meshek, nang hon dawrte'n sal leh dal tui-um belsuan in ahon dawr ua, na van neihna ding in.
Togarmah a mite'n sakol, kidouna sakol leh sabiltung in na van alei uhi.
Dedan mite nang hon dawr mite ahi ua, tui gei mun chih na sumsinna mun ahong hi a, saiha leh eboni ahon puak uhi.
Van na hauh ziak in, Edom nang hon dawr ahong hi a, emerald suang, puan sandup, puanzep, puanmalngat, khibah, agate suangte in nang ahon dawr uh.
Judah leh Israel teng nang hon dawrte ahi ua, Minnith buh leh Pannag, khuaizu, sathau leh singnai in ahon dawr uh.
Na hauh ziak in, sum-le-pai gou thil chiteng, Damaskas nang hon dawr ahong hi a, Helbon uain leh belam mulkaang in ahon dawr hi.
Uzal uain hon tawi in alei ua, na vante, sikseksa, singguithak leh kawltute na sumsinna.
Dedan in sakol tungphah puante in nang ahon dawr hi.
Arabia leh Kedar kumpipate nang hon dawrte ahi vek uh, belamnoute, belamtalte, keltalte in ahon dawr uh.
Sheba leh Raamah sumsin mite nang hon dawrte ahong hi ua, gimlim hoihpente, suangmantam chi chih leh dangka-engte in, nang ahon dawr uh.
Haran, Kanneh leh Eden, Sheba, Assuria leh Kilmad sumsin mite nang hon dawrte ahi uh.
Huaite ahi uh, nang hon dawr, puansilh hoih chi, puandum buang, puanzep, pialkhang phah ze kilawm toh, khauhual chiptak a hek in, hiaite in nang ahon dawr uh.
"Tarshish longhon leh long lian vanpote ahi ua, na hong inbul in tuipi tung ah na hong thupita hi.
Na long hawlpa'n tuipi kihot ah ahon hawllut a, suahlam huih in nang ahon nuaimang, tuipi lai ah.

Na hauhsakna, na van, na sumsinna thil, na long mite, long hawlmi, bulhtuak mite, sumsin van kheng mite, na galbawl mite tengteng, nang a om, na sung a om teng- teng toh, na siat ni in tuipi lai ah na tummang ding uh.
Na long hawl mite kikou husa in na kim a mite aling uhi.
Longkalhna peu len mite tengteng, long mite leh, tuipi a hawl mite tengteng paisuk in, luipiau ah adingh uh.
Na tungthu ah a-aw uh zak tham in asuah ding ua, khasetak in akap ding ua; alu ua leivuite buak in, vut lak ah akitholh ding uh.
Nang ziak in kimetgiau in, sai-ip puan ateng ding ua; khase lua in nakpitak a kap in nang ahon suun ding uh.
Nang hon suun in kahla asam ding ua, nang suun in Tura bang khopi kua a-om a, amah tuipi lai ah, adai sipsip hi.
Na vante'n tuipi a pan pawt in mi tampi avak kham sek; na dangka leh na van in lei kumpipate na hausak hi.
Tuipi thuk a na siat ni in, na sumsinna thil, na mite, nang toh athelthang uhi.
"Tui gei a teng mi tengteng in mulkimhuai ahon sa ua; akumpipate uh lau in asibup ua, amel uh alamdang hial hi.
Mite lak a sumsin mite'n nang ahon khoisatkhum ua, mite a ding in launa na hong suakta a, na kilang ngei nawn kei ding, chi in ahon kahkhum uhi."
